title: Review Rust raw ownership reconstruction
why: Reconstructing an owner from a raw pointer requires matching provenance, allocator, layout, and exactly-once ownership.
suggestion: Keep the transfer local and document the originating into_raw contract, allocator, layout, and unique ownership.
limitations: The rule cannot prove pointer provenance, allocator compatibility, uniqueness, or lifetime correctness.
Aliases and wrapper functions around ownership reconstruction are not resolved.
